MECHANICAL_DISTINCTION_REQUIRED_BY_LANE.claim: A REACHABLE TP1 is NOT the five-times-dead pre-TP1 arm-scope cell.
MECHANICAL_DISTINCTION_REQUIRED_BY_LANE.mechanism_reachable_tp1: exit_manager.py:483-496 -- TP1 fill SELLS tp1_qty=int(qty*tp1_qty_fraction) at entry*(1+tp1_premium_pct), ratchets runner_stop to BREAKEVEN, and sets profit_lock_armed=True. The runner then rides the POST-TP1 chandelier (exit_manager.py:506-516, trailing hwm*(1-trail_pct)) -- machinery that is validated live (risky-1's +50% exit_patch fired it on 2026-08-05 for +$347 while siblings rode to the -50% cap).
MECHANICAL_DISTINCTION_REQUIRED_BY_LANE.mechanism_dead_cell: profit_lock_arm_scope='full' (exit_manager.py:389-395) arms the trailing lock on the FULL position BEFORE any partial banks -- no profit taken, ride choked at the first trail_pct giveback. Died five times, last E1 on live machine n=190 (runner cohort -$7,758.85, 22 worse / 0 better). PERMANENT graveyard.
MECHANICAL_DISTINCTION_REQUIRED_BY_LANE.what_this_grid_never_touches: profit_lock_arm_scope stays 'post_tp1' in EVERY cell. No cell arms any lock before a partial is banked.
MECHANICAL_DISTINCTION_REQUIRED_BY_LANE.shared_risk_declared: What a reachable TP1 SHARES with the graveyard is the RESULT-side risk: any earlier profit extraction damages the runner cohort that pays for the book. That is why G3 anchor-no-regression is the operative veto, unweakened.

The formal battery: WF, OOS split, sub-window stability, BH-FDR across the whole grid -- catcap's gates had no WF/OOS/BH.
directional_predictions_frozen: P1: f0.5 cells reduce runner-anchor damage vs f0.667 at the same TP1 level (smaller banked fraction, bigger surviving runner) but do NOT flip its sign at tp1<=0.50.

P2: integer-floor degeneracy -- tp1_qty=int(qty*frac): at qty=3 f0.667 and f0.8 are IDENTICAL (both sell 2); at qty=4 f0.5 and f0.667 are IDENTICAL (both sell 2). popA is 130x qty3 + 61x qty>=4, so column pairs will partially mirror each other BY CONSTRUCTION. Stated now so nobody reports the mirror as a robustness confirmation.
P3: fraction-only cells (tp1=1.0, f0.5/f0.8) produce small deltas confined to the ~45% of popA entries whose session-max reaches +100% (many of which the CONTROL walk exits earlier anyway).
P4: NO cell clears the full auto-ratify bar. If one does, that is the finding and it ships only with guards + RED-proof + kill criterion.

gates_frozen.G2_ex_best_trade: popA delta minus the single largest POSITIVE per-trade delta still > $0.005 (drop-best only drops an actual improvement; bull_gate_atm_ssb_requalification drop_top1 semantics).
gates_frozen.G3_runner_anchor: popA runner cohort delta >= -$0.005. Cohort rule = catcap's: CONTROL rows with pnl>0 AND 'runner_stop' in exit_reason (n must equal 35, CONTROL total $15,497.25; the $276.80 selection-rule gap vs EXIT-LEAK's published $15,774.05 is a carried, disclosed caveat -- deltas are unaffected).
gates_frozen.G4_subwindow_stable: popA split into 4 sequential calendar windows: 2025H1, 2025H2, 2026Q1, 2026-04-01..07-22. PASS = delta >= -$0.005 in >= 3 of the windows containing >= 5 changed trades; if fewer than 2 windows have >= 5 changed trades, gate FAILS (insufficient dispersion to certify stability).
gates_frozen.G5_drop_best_day: popA delta minus the single most-positive DAY-level summed delta still > $0.005.
gates_frozen.G6_week_tuesday_HARD: Week 2026-08-04 delta vs CONTROL_WALK >= -$0.005. J's directive-shaped hard gate, catcap precedent: a cell that costs Tuesday cannot ship no matter what it buys elsewhere.
gates_frozen.G8_bh_fdr: Cell survives Benjamini-Hochberg at q=0.10 across the FULL 28-cell tested family (14 ribbon non-control + 14 vwap non-control). p-value = one_sample_p (ported verbatim from bull_gate_f5class_requal_2026_08_01.py:307, itself ported from shelf_hold_reclaim_study.py) over the cell's CHANGED per-trade deltas (popA for ribbon cells; week per-position deltas for vwap cells).

auto_ratify_bar_frozen.OOS_positive: popA delta restricted to entries 2026-01-01..2026-07-22 > $0 AND week total delta >= $0.
auto_ratify_bar_frozen.WF_ge_0.70: Among calendar months (2025-01..2026-07) containing >= 3 changed trades: fraction with monthly delta >= $0 must be >= 0.70. Fewer than 4 qualifying months => WF FAILS (cannot certify).
auto_ratify_bar_frozen.SHIP_rule: ALL of G1..G8 AND all four bar components -> may ship tonight per OP-11 with guards + RED-proof + one-line revert + kill criterion + REVOKE entry. ANY failure -> DO_NOT_ARM: this prereg stays FROZEN with the forward clock below, and the artifact states plainly WHICH gate failed.
auto_ratify_bar_frozen.kill_criterion_if_shipped: Cell-attributable net <= -$300 over the first 10 live sessions, OR live runner-cohort regression (any 2 live runners exited by the new TP1 below what the -50%/structure path realized) -> revert same day.
auto_ratify_bar_frozen.forward_clock_if_frozen: Re-adjudicate when risky-1's live +50% arm reaches n>=30 ribbon fills post-2026-08-03 (its own A/B is the live instrument for this exact question), or by 2026-09-05, whichever first.

descriptive_outputs_frozen.reachability_reconciliation: The lane carries two conflicting reachability claims. (a) 14% of 124 ribbon entries reach +100%, median MFE +16.3% -- LIVE-LEDGER in-trade measure (max best_premium the production exit manager saw, truncated at actual exit) on the recent live book (EOD-2026-08-05-REENTRY-SIZING.md section 1a). (b) 45.0% reach +100%, median +83.8% -- UNCONDITIONAL post-entry session max on the 391-day replay (LEVER-CATCAP-2026-08-06.md section 4, labeled upper bound). This study computes the BRIDGE: on popA, in-trade MFE under the CONTROL walk (max premium while the position is actually open) alongside the unconditional session max, so the measure gap and the population gap are separated and each claim gets a stated population + stated measure.
descriptive_outputs_frozen.per_strategy_split: Every week cell reports ribbon vs vwap contribution separately.
descriptive_outputs_frozen.tp1_fire_rate: Per cell: fraction of walked positions whose TP1 actually fills, popA and week.
descriptive_outputs_frozen.quote_luck_caveat_carried: The Thursday $210 / 3-cent stream-divergence noise floor (82/98 shared polls disagreed) is carried as a caveat on ALL week-level deltas: single-day week numbers are anecdote-scale by construction.

no_other_knobs: Within a cell exactly tp1_premium_pct and/or tp1_qty_fraction change for exactly one strategy family. profit_lock_arm_scope, trail_pct, catastrophe cap, stop_mode, entries, sizing: all FROZEN at registry+arm values. No entry filter, no cooldown, no sizing change is combined with any cell.
